QuestInfo.name: Activate Defrag 20 Times
QuestInfo.0:
Activate Defrag 20 times.

To activate Defrag, hit an enemy marked by [Hologram] Format with a Hologram skill. Defrag deals additional damage to the targeted enemy.

The [Hologram] Format skill can be obtained by equipping special equipment in the Quanah world, and automatically activates when attacking enemies afterwards.
You have a chance to get a jewel as a reward.
